articles.title: Eastgate Elementary Teams Head to Summer Tournament
articles.deck: The program begins in February and is open to all students in grade 8 and up.
body: Sign-up forms went home in backpacks this week, and the first session is set for February.

Students will meet on Wednesday afternoons in Millrace Green, and transportation will be provided for those who need it. Principal Mildred McIver said the program was built with help from parents and local volunteers.
The board will review the results at the end of the summer term.

articles.title: Xavier Yates, 90, Tailor
articles.deck: Friends remember Xavier Yates for the many years of service to Mill Hill.
body: Xavier Yates died in August at home on Harbor Terrace, at the age of 90.

Born in Mill Hill in the years after the war, Xavier Yates spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood. Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Mill Hill.
Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Canal Park Food Pantry in his or her name. Xavier Yates died in August at home on Harbor Terrace, at the age of 90.
